note: Daylight mode: a new display option for using the app outdoors in bright sun. One tap on the Daylight button in the header (or Preferences - Display - Daylight mode) switches to black on white at maximum contrast, with heavier borders, bolder small type, and darker, thicker chart lines. It overrides your theme while it is on; switch it off and your theme comes back. Display only - physics and designs untouched.
